items.title: Miss Universe 2026 Makes History as 1st Mom and Married Woman to Win Pageant
items.summary:
Miss Puerto Rico Jennifer Barreto has been crowned Miss Universe 2026 , becoming the first mother to ever win the pageant.

Barreto, 27, was named the winner during the finals at Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on Tuesday, November 24. In addition to making history as the first mom to take the crown, Barreto is also the first married woman to win.

The victory comes three years after the Miss Universe organization lifted its ban on married women, mothers and pregnant women competing in the pageant.

Barreto, a psychologist and social worker, is married to U.S. Army Sergeant Yan Carlos Barreto Calderón . The couple share a daughter named Penélope, born in 2019.

After her victory, Barreto took to social media to express gratitude for her supporters. Additionally, she gushed about the bonds she formed with her fellow competitors.

Who Is Fatima Bosch? Meet Miss Mexico Amid Miss Universe Scandal 

Miss Universe 2025 Fátima Bosch crowned her successor on Tuesday with the organization’s new crown, “The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy,” featuring 3,150 diamonds set in 18-karat white gold. The crown was designed by George Wittels and Maison d’OR.

Miss Dominican Republic Melissa Núñez was named first runner-up in the pageant. Rounding out the top five finalists were Miss Venezuela Clara Vegas , Miss Philippines Bea Millan-Windorski and Miss New Zealand Georgia Waddington .

The 2026 pageant concluded after several headline-making moments, including the news that some African contestants dropped out of the competition due to visa restrictions.…

items.summary:
Patrick Clancy ’s malpractice lawsuit is moving forward after a Massachusetts judge declined to dismiss the case against two medical professionals who treated his ex-wife, Lindsay Clancy , before she was arrested for killing their three children in January 2023.

Patrick, 36, is suing psychiatrist Jennifer Tufts , nurse practitioner Rebecca Jollotta and healthcare organizations. He claimed they provided negligent mental health care to Lindsay, 36, that led to her killing their children .

Lindsay previously pleaded not guilty to three counts of first-degree murder in connection to her children’s deaths. Throughout her high-profile trial, her attorneys argued that she was suffering from postpartum psychosis. Meanwhile, the prosecution claimed she was aware of her actions.

Judge William Sullivan declared the murder case a mistrial in September after the jury was unable to reach a unanimous verdict. The case is next expected to be tried in a retrial beginning in March 2027.

Who Is Patrick Clancy? Lindsay Clancy's Ex-Husband Played Role in Murder Trial 

Both Tufts and Jollotta testified during Lindsay’s first trial , in which they detailed what their care for her looked like.

Tufts said she started treating Lindsay in September 2022 after the mother of three reported having concerns about her anxiety. Tufts went on to treat her for 14 telehealth sessions.

Meanwhile, Jollotta said she started treating Lindsay in November 2022 after she reported issues with her anxiety and sleep deprivation.
